## Controller 1.0.51
### Harnesses & Workspace - **Separate project and Mac pickers with a checkout tray.** The headline now has its own project and Mac pickers, and the composer gains a checkout and branch tray on Mac, iPhone, and Android. - **Instant remote new threads.** New threads on a paired Mac appear right away with an empty transcript while the Mac creates them in the background, and New Thread no longer fails when that Mac hasn't connected yet. - **More reliable Muse Code sessions.** Muse threads keep sending after a reconnect, harness restart, or host exit, and keep their Controller tools when a session is detached and reattached. Muse Code now shows the Meta logo. - **OpenCode workspace recovery.** OpenCode sessions that move out of their thread's workspace are moved back automatically instead of failing to attach.
### Mac & iPhone - **Plan chip morph.** The composer's task plan chip now expands into its card with the same lens morph as the reasoning effort control, clipped cleanly inside the glass.
### Android - **Quieter Sea Glass chrome.** Headers, docks, and buttons use calmer glass with crisp edges and a fine grain, and dark glass now etches light text and icons into the surface. - **Calmer sheets and switches.** Grouped sheet rows use a subtle tinted fill instead of a bright white card, switches rest on neutral glass when off, and Seafoam text has more contrast.

## Controller 1.0.51
### Harnesses & Workspace - **Muse Code integration.** Adds full support for Muse Code through its native `muse serve` host, including model discovery, usage limits, context window tracking, native approval options, session lifecycle management, and Android parity. - **Worktrees settings pane.** View, inspect, and delete managed worktree checkouts directly from Settings → Worktrees. - **Antigravity & ACP compaction and media.** Supports Antigravity 1.3 native compaction steps and the ACP compaction lifecycle, sends file and supported video attachments through standard ACP prompt content, preserves events arriving with WebSocket relay upgrades, and fixes unsigned Claude thinking replay after native session rebuilds.
### Mac & iPhone Transcript Performance - **Native streaming code fences & TextKit draw-time coloring.** Draws code syntax colors and streaming fade opacity directly during TextKit glyph drawing, retains laid-out code fence text views across row eviction, closing fence markers, and turn completion, and incrementally colors growing tokens. - **Faster long-thread scrolling & tool output.** Collapses contiguous runs of unrealized transcript rows into a single spacer, streams Mac tool output into an append-only native text view, and preserves open transcript disclosures across row eviction, regrouping, and mobile viewing sessions.
### Android - **Physics-based Sea Glass morphs & sheet detents.** Adds S-curve ease-in/ease-out motion across Sea Glass morphs, refines live backdrop redraws and sheet detent handoffs, and stacks the Inbox header cleanly when one row does not fit. - **Connect questions & approvals.** Fixes inline prompt and question replies for OpenCode and Connect, hardens multi-question validation, and prunes resolved approvals cleanly.

## Controller 1.0.51
### Android - **Trigger-to-card Sea Glass lens morphs.** Tapping the composer `+` Attach button, Send long-press, Context Window ring, Model chip, conversation header pill, or chat actions button morphs a liquid Sea Glass lens directly out of the control's screen coordinates into the expanded card or sheet and retracts smoothly back on close. - **120 Hz motion & spring tuning.** Locks high-refresh-rate rendering across animations, eliminates per-frame backdrop blur thrashing, and tunes open/close spring stiffness to match iPhone transition timing. - **Swipe-to-full-page action sheets.** Swipe up anywhere on a floating Sea Glass sheet to expand from the compact detent to full page with a full-bleed Sea Glass tint wash, and swipe down to step back or dismiss. - **Context Window card & morphing Inbox search.** Aligns the 18 dp composer Context Window ring and floating multi-segment Context Usage card with iPhone, and separates the Inbox Search button into a circular Sea Glass control that morphs horizontally into the full-width search bar. - **In-card model menus & Sea Glass composer overlays.** Replaces popup menus in the Model Card with an in-card choice face for Speed tiers and model options, and renders composer `+` Attach and Send long-press menus as blurred Sea Glass overlays. - **Refined touch states & ripples.** Removes 3D perspective tilt and drag tint shifts across Sea Glass controls, clips button ripples cleanly to oval pills and cards, and fixes a radial gradient color-space crash on touch.
### Mac and iPhone - **Faster workspace switching & lower idle CPU.** Eliminates background 1 Hz relative-time layout passes on hidden Settings, Usage, and Pull Request pages, scopes workspace environment updates so switching threads or Settings panes no longer invalidates the sidebar, and coarsens Connect device and provider status updates. - **Cleaner OpenCode shutdown.** Suppresses expected socket disconnects during OpenCode daemon shutdown and restart.
